name: Be a Nurse
desc:
🩺 Welcome to Be a Nurse! 🏥
Ready to heal the world? Start your nursing journey today!
New updates every week!

🧑‍⚕️Begin your career as an Orientee and work your way up the ranks!
🤲Complete patient care tasks and unlock new hospital units.
🏥Tackle real-world scenarios in ER, ICU, PACU, and more!

🔓 Use Code: NEW, 100_LIKeS, 1k_likes, 5k_LiKES, 12k_likES, K_25LIKES, 50_Likes_k
Next code unlocks at 120k Likes!
❤️ Support us by liking, favoriting, and joining our group for exclusive codes and updates!

Tags: CNA, Nurse, Doctor, ER, ICU, Hospital, Simulation, Roleplay, Patient Care, Nursing Simulator, Tycoon, Be a CNA, CNA simulator, Be a Nurse
